Digital Marketing Executive

Help turn creative ideas and marketing plans into work that gets out into the world.

Digital marketingOn-site / hybrid

THE KIND OF WORK
  • Support content planning, publishing and campaign coordination.

  • Track agreed campaign metrics and organise useful updates.
WHAT TO SHARE
